entities.summary: André Blattmann was the Swiss Lieutenant General and Chief of the Armed Forces from 1 March 2009 until 31 December 2016. He led the Swiss army after the leave of Roland Nef ad interim on 25 July 2008.

entities.summary: André Blattmann was the Swiss Lieutenant General and Chief of the Armed Forces from 1 March 2009 until 31 December 2016. He led the Swiss army after the leave of Roland Nef ad interim on 25 July 2008.
